text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from buying 
equipment for training...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah... That hot spring inn—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is an inn I once saw in a 
gardening magazine. If I recall 
correctly...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
There is an open-air bath where you can 
hear the babbling of a clear stream. From 
the room, you can enjoy the natural trees 
and wild flowers—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
This is a place I've always wanted to 
visit someday. To think I'd run into you 
in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly, I remember. I had received a 
raffle ticket while running errands just a 
moment ago.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, go ahead and give it a spin

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: However—are you sure that is all right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't plan on entering the lottery 
anyway. If you use the tickets, at least 
they won't go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I see. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I will turn the wheel with 
utmost care. Please, let me win—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or excitedly spun the 
raffle drum's handle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My—fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To think it actually came true... I—I 
can't believe it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
These are tickets to the inn you've been 
longing to visit. I hope you take your 
time to thoroughly enjoy it whenever the 
race schedule settles down.
choice_data_list: Go and relax with someone dear to you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――...Yes. I'll give it a little thought.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Someone... precious to me.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(My friends, my dad, my mom. But, after 
all—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The person I most want to find peace of 
mind at that hot spring is you.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(............ I wonder if inviting them 
would be a bother.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(They're a kind person, after all. I don't 
want them to push themselves; I want them 
to go only if they truly want to—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah— "In spring, the wild cherry blossoms 
shine vividly. In summer, the mountain 
lilies; in autumn, red spider lilies; and 
in winter, daffodils."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"They're sure to bring you peace of 
mind... I'd really love for you to see 
them."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Together. What... do you say?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: My— Are you practicing for a play?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No... um, this is, well—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, a vaguely nervous-looking 
Curren Bouquetd'or invited me on a hot 
springs trip.
choice_data_list:
Thanks. If you're okay with me, let's go 
together.

Thank you. If you don't mind having me, 
let's go together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—by all means.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, once the Twinkle Series had 
settled down, we decided to take a trip to 
a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, to think I actually won... That 
Salisbury steak looks absolutely 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um, this is a bit sudden, but— would you 
like to have dinner together tonight?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there is something else I'd like 
to treat you to, alongside the Salisbury 
steak—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Curren Bouquetd'or served was a salad 
sprinkled with edible flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: They're edible flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You can grow them in a home garden, too. I 
happened to pick some this morning, in 
fact.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I heard it also has a 
well-balanced amount of vitamins and 
minerals—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I believe it goes wonderfully with 
hamburger steak as well. Please, go ahead 
and try some.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. What a relief. So you don't 
dislike it after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um—to tell the truth...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
We also have vichyssoise garnished with 
edible flowers, and lemon jelly prepared 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It's something I've been wanting to make 
for quite some time."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like... would you care to join 
me?
choice_data_list: I would love to have some!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —! Fufufu. Yes, I'll bring it right over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The colorful, lavish dinner lifted our 
spirits, and we spent a delightful time 
together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My, so many carrots—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It was good fortune. But— what should I do 
with so many?
choice_data_list:
Why don't you bring some refreshments for 
everyone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The academy is full of growing Umamusume 
with big appetites. I'm sure everyone will 
gladly accept them.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Refreshments— That certainly sounds like 
a good idea."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh, from the lottery? Ahaha, that's an 
incredible amount!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll be sure to use it for 
tonight's dinner!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's so sparkly! Thank you~! Can I 
post this on Umastagram?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
My... at a lottery draw. You certainly 
possess wonderful luck.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Right? Smells so good♪ Maybe I'll put 
some in tomorrow's mixed juice."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you brought this all the way from the 
Miho dorm? Thank you so much~! Hey, 
Maru-chan. About tonight's cake making—"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah! Let's make carrot cake too, 
not just vanilla! Once it's done, I'll 
bring some to Bouquet-san as well!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Now for the rest— ...Oh? That last one 
was the end of it, wasn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu. My heart feels so warm. To be 
gifted so many smiles—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(“A mountain of carrots”—— My, what a 
wonderful prize you managed to win.)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like you've won something 
quite cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A lovely aroma. It's sure to be sweet and 
rich—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know. Would it be alright if I 
made a boxed lunch for tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. With such lovely colors, I'm sure we 
can make a beautiful boxed lunch.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what shape I should use— 
Chrysanthemums, twisted plum blossoms, 
roses would be lovely too...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, inside the boxed lunch she 
brought me were several carrots carved 
into the shapes of various flowers.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My— I am so sorry, after you went through 
the trouble of giving this to me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“Still, umm―― I was just about to run out 
of tissues, so this really helps...”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...However, it's still frustrating after 
all. Testing one's luck is truly a 
difficult thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or looked just a little 
bit disappointed.
